status.current: eliminated by Ikki in first round but remains at venue supporting Byakuya

personality.summary: Easygoing and teasing after defeat, but still thoughtful enough to warn Byakuya about Ikki's unpredictability.

abilities_owned: Tiger Bite / 虎噬 from prior match

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Recent conqueror; Moroboshi respects his skill and warns Byakuya not to assume Ikki will move as predicted.
relationships.byakuya-jonosaki: Friend and schoolmate; teases him but visits to provide a genuine warning before Byakuya fights Ikki.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Watches the fallout of her and Akatsuki's matches as a fellow tournament observer.

periods.summary: Although eliminated by Ikki, Moroboshi remains cheerful around the bathhouse and preparation rooms. He rescues Ikki from an awkward moment with Byakuya's overzealous body study by kicking Byakuya away and explaining the misunderstanding. Before Byakuya's match with Ikki, Moroboshi teases him about facing Sara afterward but also warns that Ikki's techniques are too variable to be fully predicted. Byakuya dismisses the warning because he believes Ikki cannot spend Ittou Shura before Sara, setting up Ikki's immediate contradiction of that assumption.

key_events.summary: Intervenes when Byakuya's study of Ikki becomes too physically intrusive.
Warns Byakuya that Ikki may not act as predicted.
